_comment: ONE clip of the whole in-cab display, not four of its panels.
Four separate <video> elements looping independently drift apart within
seconds, and the moment they do the display contradicts itself: the rear
feed shows a truck at 2.9m while the plan view beside it says all clear.
On a proximity-detection demo that is the one inconsistency you cannot
have. One decode, one timeline, always self-consistent — and the chapter
walks the panels by dimming the others over the top, which needs no
The window is the full escalation arc: objects distant and the arcs white,
closing to amber, into red alert, then receding. It does not loop
seamlessly and is not meant to — the rep talks over one pass.
